items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: A friend of mine, he's dead now, named Fulbright. And sent a whole box to me here

ctx.x: Yeah, in the '40s. Let me see. One I played at (?), and Cooper is on that record with me. We went back to the man and he said the record never did anything, and then I kept on writing, and they said the man didn't work there no more that had come down here... We didn't go to (?) when we made it down there, we thought he was working.

Then I had a bunch of records sent to me around '49(?) from California. They all got away. I had a whole stack of them. A friend of mine, he's dead now, named Fulbright. And sent a whole box to me here, right here at this house, here... And they all got away from me, and I had one. See, I run up on somebody the other month who said they had one of my records.
